title: The Mission
label: Veterans Day · Special screening · 11 November 2026
description: A Veteran-made short film about recognizing another Veteran in need and choosing not to walk away.
byline: A story of one Veteran helping another.
note: Created by Army Veteran Ameena Brown, this short film follows two Veterans and the ripple effect of one person reaching out. It is a story about the part of service that can continue long after the uniform comes off.
creator: Ameena Brown · with videography and editing by Nicole “NicNak” Smith
contentNote: Viewer note: includes scenes of homelessness and a Veteran experiencing hardship. The film focuses on connection and mutual support.
